opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships. Examples include charities, trusts, community and voluntary groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based or church organisations, local authorities and other public sector organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, awarding grants from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, taking into account four investment principles. Open all year round with no deadline.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by a not-for-profit organisation. Examples include charities, trusts, community and voluntary groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based or church organisations, local authorities and other public sector organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, awarding grants from £250,000 to £10m. Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest, then typically go through a development phase and a delivery phase. Applications have quarterly deadlines (next: 12 November 2026).
